name: rss2pub
description: Atom to ActivityPub bridge — each feed becomes a followable fediverse actor

scripts.dev: yarn workspace @rss2pub/atom-feed build && yarn workspace @rss2pub/rss-feed build && yarn web-ui:build && node --watch --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx src/web/main.ts
scripts.web-ui:build: yarn workspace @rss2pub/web-ui build:types && yarn workspace @rss2pub/web-ui build:server && yarn workspace @rss2pub/web-ui build:client
scripts.typecheck: yarn workspace @rss2pub/atom-feed typecheck && yarn workspace @rss2pub/rss-feed typecheck && yarn workspace @rss2pub/web-ui typecheck && yarn workspace @rss2pub/web-ui build:types && tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.web-ui-tests.json
scripts.build: yarn workspace @rss2pub/atom-feed build && yarn workspace @rss2pub/rss-feed build && yarn web-ui:build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test: yarn workspace @rss2pub/atom-feed build && yarn workspace @rss2pub/rss-feed build && yarn web-ui:build && vitest run
scripts.test:unit: yarn workspace @rss2pub/atom-feed build && yarn workspace @rss2pub/rss-feed build && yarn web-ui:build && vitest run --project unit
scripts.test:e2e: yarn workspace @rss2pub/atom-feed build && yarn workspace @rss2pub/rss-feed build && yarn web-ui:build && vitest run --project e2e
